title: Longyearbyen-from-above-Hiorthfjellet.jpg
author: Bjørn Christian Tørrissen
description: Longyearbyen seen from the north, stretching from the Gruvedalen area on the left (east) side, and Nybyen in the back of the photo (south), towards Skjeringa and the coal power plant and the port on the right (west) side.
